summary: Euro Truck Simulator entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows Steam build with required DLC installed

emulation.notes: Native PC route; wheel/controller configuration matters more than emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC current build, high settings, current DLC

primary.version: Current Steam build with owned map/cargo DLC installed as needed
primary.why: Euro Truck Simulator 2 is actively maintained on PC platforms, and Windows has the strongest graphics, mod, input, and capture ceiling. SCS's download page points buyers to Steam for the auto-updated full version, while Linux and macOS are useful alternates without unique content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows build, current patch, wheel/controller profile as desired, and any map or truck DLC needed for the specific route being archived. Record the game version and DLC list because this is a long-running updated simulator.

all_releases.fidelity: Main PC release with the highest graphics/settings, mod, and capture ceiling.
all_releases.reason: primary: best practical archive route and the platform with strongest support for current patches and DLC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC-family route, but not a higher-fidelity or more complete content path than Windows for capture.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful ownership/system alternate; no sourced exclusive route over Windows.
skip: the Mac release is part of the same Steam ownership family; no exclusive content over Windows exists.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X/S planned listings
all_releases.fidelity: Console listings are not a released archive route at this checkpoint.
all_releases.reason: skip: treat as future scope until the console versions actually launch and version differences can be sourced.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive content split is sourced. Completeness is mainly a DLC/version-state question on the PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a live, long-updated simulator rather than a remaster. Record installed DLC and patch version; revisit when announced console versions actually release.

entries.title: Euro Truck Simulator

primary.why: The original Euro Truck Simulator is a separate 2008 SCS Software game, not a duplicate of Euro Truck Simulator 2. The current Steam PC release is the cleanest legal route, while the sequel remains a separate long-running simulator entry.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows build with a wheel/controller if desired. Record storefront/build, OS, resolution, input device, route/cargo state, and whether ETS2 was compared separately.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving a Mac build.
secondary.why: Mac mod compatibility differs from Windows, so Windows remains the main archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC truck-sim route with current Steam access.
all_releases.reason: primary: target artifact for the 2008 game.

all_releases.fidelity: Mac route for the same original game.
all_releases.reason: secondary: useful platform route, but not better than Windows for capture/mod compatibility.
skip: already tracked separately and should not replace the original 2008 entry.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The main distinction is original game versus sequel, not a platform-exclusive content split.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge the 2008 original with Euro Truck Simulator 2. Record input device and any compatibility fixes.
